title: Last Dev-C : lost connection to watch face
symptom: After updating the phone apk and watch apk to the last dev-c, the connection to the watch face is lost. The AAPS Wear menu shows the correct watch name, but BGs, COB, and IOB are stale and not updated even when sending resend data to watch.
cause: The issue is caused by depended libraries that are old; to make them work on modern Android, jettifier could be used, but it was disabled in a commit.
fix: Enable jetifier again and rebuild, or use pre-jetifier on dependencies as described in the linked article.
evidence_quote: Issue is caused be depended libraries that are old, to make them work on modern Android, jettifier could be used. However this was disabled in commit https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/e7c41beab74306ee3b5c68c41aac9bf05da36034
